phase1_leaf_result.part98_scope: 64 equal-weight synthetic scenarios across immutable-release deletion, repository delete/recreate, attestation deletion, target restore, ambiguous effect response, and stale-transition identifier reuse/newness; compared current release read, attestation read, tag-name anti-reuse oracle, and a hypothetical irreversible read-visible floor.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive_evidence: GitHub immutable-release tag-name non-reuse remains a strong write-time duplicate-replay fence for a previously used stable tag name, including repository resurrection.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: No concrete documented read-visible monotonic minimum-generation floor was found after deletion: current release reads lose deleted release objects, artifact attestations are deletable/unfindable, and tag-name anti-reuse is observable as a mutating write oracle and cannot reject a previously-unused stale lower-generation identifier.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A target/repository-native non-mutating read endpoint or sink-side rule that exposes/enforces a monotonic minimum generation across release deletion and repository delete/recreate and cannot itself be rolled back, deleted, hidden or bypassed by a previously-unused stale transition identifier.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only the Part98 64-scenario abstract model and bounded GitHub documentation surfaces. No arbitrary external sink inherits these semantics and undocumented internal tombstones are not assumed absent or usable.

continuation: Part99: execute exactly one bounded read-only indistinguishability leaf for the hidden immutable-tag reservation state. Construct two histories with identical current documented read surfaces: A = candidate tag name never used; B = same tag name backed an immutable release and both release/tag later deleted. Verify whether any public read-only GitHub endpoint distinguishes A from B without creating/updating a ref/release, protected/admin setup as an outcome dependency, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, or an external coordinator. If none exists, formalize tag-name anti-reuse as a service-side write-time duplicate fence rather than a stateless read-visible freshness floor and preserve sink-side minimum-generation enforcement as the unresolved alternative child.
